evidence_source: Maintainer-reported runtime observations; not exhaustive certification.

evidence: no duplicate legacy data-path transport observed
targets.note: Strict static transport exclusivity is not provable from runtime evidence alone. Qualcomm qti-testscripts SIGABRT is unrelated vendor userspace evidence, not a kernel/KSU/SuSFS failure.
Maintainer-confirmed Cheetah support in sultan-shiba-susfs-minimal; this runtime record covers Pixel 7 Pro with manual hooks, not every supported device.

recent_events.text: REVIEW_FINDINGS_RECONCILED: reconciled xxKSU drift to master 5da23982; removed dead boot_completed symbol and fixed webview_zygote condition in Patch 11; restored lock-free returns in GKI 6.12 namespace; removed dead try-umount replacements in Sultan; restored lifecycle test fixtures.

GKI Android 16 / 6.12 LSM+BL: runtime healthy with warnings; SuSFS v2.3.0. No observed KSU/SuSFS Oops/BUG/panic or duplicate legacy transport. Runtime evidence alone does not prove strict static transport exclusivity.
Pixel 7 Pro Sultan 6.1 manual hooks: runtime healthy with warnings; KernelSU 3.3.0-52, SuSFS v2.3.0. Manual paths, ADD_TRY_UMOUNT, umount, zygote/WebView and open redirect verified.
